value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco there yet. The first one is being built at 3471 Wyecroft Rd, near Burloak Dr and the QEW on the Burlington/Oakville edge, with a target opening of fall 2027. Burlington already has one, but I couldn't find its address. For one open now, a third-party deals site lists a warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd in Mississauga as serving Oakville, though I couldn't confirm that on Costco's own site. I also can't tell which is closest to you without knowing where in Oakville you are.
